is_anopheles.evidence: Box 3 (page 5) focuses on Anopheles mosquitoes (e.g., Anopheles gambiae and A. coluzzii) as malaria vectors.

reports_target_markers.evidence: Box 3 (page 5) mentions the introgression of the insecticide resistance mutation 'Vgsc-L1014F from A. gambiae to A. coluzzii'.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: This is an opinion/review paper; no genotype counts, sample sizes, or allele frequencies are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: No field mosquito collections or testing were conducted in this study; it only discusses literature findings.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an 'OPINION' article synthesizing published literature on parasite and vector hybridization, not a primary empirical study.

sub_country_location.evidence: No primary field locations are sampled or analyzed.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No primary mosquito sampling was conducted.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Not applicable as this is a perspective/opinion piece without primary data.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data exists or is needed.

assessment.summary: This is an opinion article reviewing hybridization and introgression in parasites and disease vectors, citing prior studies on Vgsc-L1014F introgression between An. gambiae and An. coluzzii. It does not report primary empirical genotype data.
exclusion_reasons: Not a primary empirical study (opinion/review article).
Does not report extractable genotype data (no genotype or allele counts/frequencies).
Does not test African field populations directly.
